episodes.name: Family Reunion: Episode 1
episodes.overviewEn: Mari McCabe, an orphan young woman, is chased through the city exactly 3 days after she was bailed out of jail by her foster father. She squares off with The Flash and Arrow.

episodes.name: Family Reunion: Episode 2
episodes.overviewEn: Vixen hones her skills and learns about her past.

episodes.name: Family Reunion: Episode 3
episodes.overviewEn: Vixen gets an unexpected house call from a couple of heroes.

episodes.name: Family Reunion: Episode 4
episodes.overviewEn: Vixen pushes her abilities to the limit to escape The Flash and Arrow.

episodes.name: Family Reunion: Episode 6
episodes.overviewEn: Mari embraces her destiny as Vixen.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 1
episodes.overviewEn: Vixen teams up with The Flash and Firestorm to save her city.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 2
episodes.overviewEn: Vixen investigates a stolen pendant from her family's past.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 3
episodes.overviewEn: Vixen learns her enemy may have more power than she does.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 4
episodes.overviewEn: Vixen goes totem hunting in Star City with assistance from some super-helpful friends.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 5
episodes.overviewEn: Vixen, Kuasa, the Atom, and Black Canary face Eshu on the streets of Detroit... and one of them will die.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 6
episodes.overviewEn: Vixen accepts her destiny as she draws on all of the spirits of the animals to destroy the source of Eshu's power.
